# Project: Cosmic Signature Calculator
# Description: Takes birth data, calculates Western astrology (sun/moon/ascendant/houses) and Chinese Bazi Four Pillars, synthesizes them into a unified profile, and generates a personalized 3D Cymatics-style visualization as a standalone HTML file.

birth_form = HumanTrigger {
  label: "Birth Data Input"
  title: "Enter Your Birth Data"
  description: "Your exact birth details are needed for precise astrological and Bazi calculations."
  fields: [
    {"fieldType": "text_input", "key": "birthdate", "label": "Birth Date (YYYY-MM-DD)", "placeholder": "e.g. 1990-03-15"},
    {"fieldType": "text_input", "key": "birth_time", "label": "Birth Time (HH:MM, 24h)", "placeholder": "e.g. 14:35"},
    {"fieldType": "text_input", "key": "birth_city", "label": "Birth City", "placeholder": "e.g. Munich"},
    {"fieldType": "text_input", "key": "birth_country", "label": "Birth Country", "placeholder": "e.g. Germany"}
  ]
}

  label: "Bafe Astrology API Key"
}

geocode = ExecPython(
  birth_city: String,
  birth_country: String
) -> (
  lat: Number,
  lon: Number,
  timezone: String
) {
  label: "Geocode Birth City"
  dependencies: ```
geopy==2.4.1
timezonefinder==6.5.2
  ```
  code: ```
from geopy.geocoders import Nominatim
from timezonefinder import TimezoneFinder

geolocator = Nominatim(user_agent="cosmic_signature")
location = geolocator.geocode(f"{birth_city}, {birth_country}")
lat = location.latitude
lon = location.longitude

tf = TimezoneFinder()
timezone = tf.timezone_at(lat=lat, lng=lon)

return {"lat": lat, "lon": lon, "timezone": timezone or "UTC"}
  ```
}
geocode.birth_city = birth_form.birth_city
geocode.birth_country = birth_form.birth_country

parse_chart = ExecPython(
  response_body: String
) -> (
  sun_sign: String,
  moon_sign: String,
  ascendant: String,
  houses: String,
  western_summary: String,
  bazi_year: String,
  bazi_month: String,
  bazi_day: String,
  bazi_hour: String,
  day_master: String,
  bazi_summary: String,
  wuxing_planets: String,
  wuxing_bazi: String,
  harmony_index: Number,
  dominant_planet_element: String,
  dominant_bazi_element: String,
  numeric_signature: Number
) {
  label: "Parse Chart Response"
  code: ```
import json
import math

data = json.loads(response_body)

SIGNS = ["Aries","Taurus","Gemini","Cancer","Leo","Virgo",
         "Libra","Scorpio","Sagittarius","Capricorn","Aquarius","Pisces"]

def deg_to_sign(deg):
    return SIGNS[int(deg / 30) % 12]

positions = {p["name"]: p for p in data["positions"]}
sun_sign = positions["Sun"]["sign_name"]
moon_sign = positions["Moon"]["sign_name"]

asc_deg = data["angles"]["Ascendant"]
ascendant = deg_to_sign(asc_deg)

house_list = []
for i in range(1, 13):
    deg = data["houses"][str(i)]
    house_list.append(f"H{i}: {deg_to_sign(deg)} ({round(deg,1)}°)")
houses = " | ".join(house_list)

planets_summary = []
for name in ["Sun","Moon","Mercury","Venus","Mars","Jupiter","Saturn"]:
    if name in positions:
        p = positions[name]
        retro = " ℞" if p["is_retrograde"] else ""
        planets_summary.append(f"{name}: {p['sign_name']} {round(p['degree_in_sign'],1)}°{retro}")
western_summary = ", ".join(planets_summary) + f" | ASC: {ascendant} | MC: {deg_to_sign(data['angles']['MC'])}"

bazi = data["bazi"]["pillars"]
def fmt_pillar(p):
    return f"{p['stem']} {p['branch']} ({p['animal']}, {p['element']})"

bazi_year = fmt_pillar(bazi["year"])
bazi_month = fmt_pillar(bazi["month"])
bazi_day = fmt_pillar(bazi["day"])
bazi_hour = fmt_pillar(bazi["hour"])
day_master = data["bazi"]["day_master"]
bazi_summary = f"Year: {bazi_year} | Month: {bazi_month} | Day: {bazi_day} | Hour: {bazi_hour} | Day Master: {day_master}"

wx = data["wuxing"]
def fmt_wuxing(d):
    return ", ".join(f"{k}: {round(v,2)}" for k, v in d.items())

wuxing_planets = fmt_wuxing(wx["from_planets"])
wuxing_bazi = fmt_wuxing(wx["from_bazi"])
harmony_index = float(wx["harmony_index"])
dominant_planet_element = wx["dominant_planet"]
dominant_bazi_element = wx["dominant_bazi"]

year_idx = bazi["year"]["stem_index"]
month_idx = bazi["month"]["stem_index"]
day_idx = bazi["day"]["stem_index"]
hour_idx = bazi["hour"]["stem_index"]
numeric_signature = (year_idx * 1000 + month_idx * 100 + day_idx * 10 + hour_idx) % 360

return {
    "sun_sign": sun_sign,
    "moon_sign": moon_sign,
    "ascendant": ascendant,
    "houses": houses,
    "western_summary": western_summary,
    "bazi_year": bazi_year,
    "bazi_month": bazi_month,
    "bazi_day": bazi_day,
    "bazi_hour": bazi_hour,
    "day_master": day_master,
    "bazi_summary": bazi_summary,
    "wuxing_planets": wuxing_planets,
    "wuxing_bazi": wuxing_bazi,
    "harmony_index": harmony_index,
    "dominant_planet_element": dominant_planet_element,
    "dominant_bazi_element": dominant_bazi_element,
    "numeric_signature": numeric_signature
}
  ```
}

Return ONLY the complete HTML code, nothing else.
